overview: A clean, modern, mobile-friendly website for EduMind Tuitions — a Kannada-only tuition center in Bengaluru. Features warm dark brown/orange gradient design with gold accents, Kannada script, grade cards (1–8), board tiles, tutor profile, and a sticky free demo bar.
features: Kannada-only tuition center website for grades 1–8
Warm dark brown/orange gradient with gold accents and Kannada script
Grade tiles for classes 1–8 and CBSE/ICSE/State Board cards
Tutor profile: Vasundhara Bhat with 10+ years of experience
Sticky bottom bar with free demo class button
Batch timings, location, and contact sections
